query:
SELECT id as "id!: i32", 
scorer_account_id as "scorer_account_id!: String", 
target_account_id as "target_account_id!: String", 
reason as "reason!: String", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime" FROM score_card_skips WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR id = $2::int4) AND (NOT $3::boolean OR id = ANY(CAST($4 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $5::boolean OR scorer_account_id = $6::varchar) AND (NOT $7::boolean OR target_account_id = $8::varchar) AND (NOT $9::boolean OR reason = $10::text) AND (NOT $11::boolean OR created_at = $12::timestamptz) ORDER BY 
      (CASE ($13 = 'Id' AND NOT $14) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($13 = 'Id' AND $14) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($13 = 'ScorerAccountId' AND NOT $14) WHEN true THEN scorer_account_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($13 = 'ScorerAccountId' AND $14) WHEN true THEN scorer_account_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($13 = 'TargetAccountId' AND NOT $14) WHEN true THEN target_account_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($13 = 'TargetAccountId' AND $14) WHEN true THEN target_account_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($13 = 'Reason' AND NOT $14) WHEN true THEN reason ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($13 = 'Reason' AND $14) WHEN true THEN reason ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($13 = 'CreatedAt' AND NOT $14) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($13 = 'CreatedAt' AND $14) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
     LIMIT $15 OFFSET $16
